body.x: Mevics introduced posture correction device ‘mevics’ at ‘CES 2017 Unveiled’ which is held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th.
Mevics analyzes the posture, exercise and health condition of users via smartphone app and provides proper information to correct the posture.
It is effective for people who has an irregular lifestyle and wrong posture. Especially it works for students or workers who use computers for a long time.
It is so small that users can put it in their pockets. It counts user’s footsteps and calorie consumption.

Meanwhile, CES (Consumer Technology Show), which is the world's largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow, is a good opportunity to figure out the flow of the global electronic industry at a glance and is held on every January by CTA (Consumer Technology Association).
